items.html: Indeed you must know that just as in holiness there are the four worlds ABYA, whose root is but ten Sefirot that expand within them, sorting after sorting and degree after degree as above, so it is in the ABYA of the shells: the root of them all is from the sortings of the kings that could not be sorted, and they are eleven Sefirot. And this is what is written in the Zohar, Parashat Teruma, p. 164b: “To the Sitra Achra they give a greater number, yet in its counting it is in deficiency, such as eleven.” And the intention is that although they give it a greater number — for in holiness they are ten Sefirot and in the shells eleven — on the contrary, this is to its deficiency. And this is because, although they are eleven, they are only nine; for these eleven are the seven of the seven kings and the two posteriors of AVI [Aba ve Ima], which are altogether only nine. Indeed, when AVI divide into two, they will have four posteriors, and then they will all be eleven, as above.
